title: Cleopatra to Hello Kitty: two paintings, 266 popes and a golf selfie
description: A Baroque painting, Rome's first dynasty, a Renaissance fresco, the line of popes, a golf selfie and a Yokohama reception connect Cleopatra to Hello Kitty.
hook: How is Cleopatra connected to Hello Kitty?

image.file: File:César remet Cléopâtre sur le trône d'Égypte - Pierre de Cortone.jpg

links.line: Around 1637, Pietro da Cortona painted Julius Caesar giving Cleopatra the throne of Egypt.

people.name: Tiberius

links.line: Caesar's heir Augustus became Rome's first emperor, and his dynasty ended with Nero.

image.file: File:Cappella brancacci, Disputa di Simon Mago (restaurato), Filippino Lippi.jpg

links.line: Around 1482, Filippino Lippi painted Nero putting the apostle Peter, the first pope, on trial.

image.file: File:Donald Trump Pope Francis Melania Trump in 2017.jpg

links.line: In 2017, President Donald Trump visited Pope Francis at the Vatican.

image.file: File:Selfie of Shinzo Abe and Donald Trump.jpg

links.line: In 2019, Japan's prime minister Shinzo Abe took a golf selfie with Trump near Tokyo.

image.file: File:Welcome Reception co-hosted by Prime Minister of Japan and Mayor of the City of Yokohama (48636282272).jpg

links.line: And three months later, Hello Kitty joined Abe on stage at a summit reception in Yokohama.
